note.question: How may management needs to be careful in setting the information disclosure policy, as the key problem parameters affect its impact on system throughput and social welfare in opposite directions?
note.overview: Customer joining behavior is of major concern for service systems where the service capacity is uncertain. It remains unclear whether customer inference of uncertain service capacity can lead to follow the crowd (FTC) behavior. Management can release capacity information, but how it affects system performance needs to be understood.

source.quote: Problem definition: Customer joining behavior is of major concern for service systems where the service capacity is uncertain.
Methodology: We use a single-server queue to analyze the joining behavior of customers who infer the actual service capacity based on the queue length upon arrival.
